sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 90. Confuses for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 10% Life Drain for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 60 seconds.
